name: ads-frame-audit
description: Deterministic frame-by-frame QA audit of any registered superbot-ads spot (tools/audit.mjs --spot NAME): steps the ad loop with a virtual rAF clock in headless Chromium at 30fps across 16:9 / 1:1 / 9:16, and runs layout invariants — odometer alignment + value vs spec at rest, HTML text-block overlaps, SVG chart-text overlaps (label × label, label × series line, label × data point, every frame), typewriter completeness vs exact strings, dwell ≥1.5s, ≤42-char cards, offstage clipping during wide shots, clean loop seam. Reach for it after ANY change to any assets/spots/*.js, ad.js, ad.css or the audit-relevant pages. Returns violations[] (empty = clean).

params.name: spot
params.description: Which registered spot to audit (see assets/spots.js). Defaults to cheaper.

cases.name: benchmark-all-ratios-clean
cases.expect: violations=0 across 16:9+1:1+9:16 — proves the chart-text overlap invariant passes on the densest spot

cases.name: default-spot-still-audits
cases.expect: runs with no arguments and returns a structured result (clean or violations, never a crash)
